jobs.title: Manager, Digital Product Analytics
jobs.location: Office - US, Las Vegas, NV 975 Kelly Johnson Dr
jobs.description:
Las Vegas, Nevada

The SHOW comes alive at MGM Resorts International

Have you ever wondered what it would be like to work in a place full of excitement, diversity, and entertainment? Are you enthusiastic about being a team player in one of the most fascinating industries in the world? At MGM Resorts, we seek individuals like YOU to create unique and show-stopping experiences for our guests.

THE JOB:

The Manager of Digital Product Analytics (Insights & Implementation) is a subject matter expert responsible for driving actionable insights and ensuring reliable measurement across MGM Resorts' digital products, including web, mobile app, booking and eCommerce flows, digital check-in, digital key, loyalty experiences, and other customer-facing journeys. This role operates at the intersection of analytics and implementation partnering with Product, UX, Engineering, and Analytics leaders to define measurement needs, ensure accurate instrumentation, and translate customer behavior into clear recommendations that improve adoption, conversion, and digital revenue.

THE DAY-TO-DAY:
- Own digital product reporting and insight delivery for assigned web/app experiences, translating customer behavior, funnel performance, and engagement patterns into clear, actionable recommendations through strong storytelling and stakeholder communication.
- Define measurement strategy and requirements for product initiatives, partnering with Product, UX, Engineering, and stakeholders to establish KPIs, success criteria, and measurement approaches that support both day-to-day performance monitoring and deeper customer journey analysis.
- Partner on instrumentation to ensure accurate, scalable data collection, contributing to (and in some cases directly owning) tracking specifications, event schemas, data layer requirements, and tagging approaches across web and app experiences.
- Support and/or lead tagging implementation and governance activities using tag management systems (e.g., Adobe Launch or similar), including coordinating releases, maintaining standards and documentation, and ensuring consistency across platforms and experiences.
- Drive experimentation measurement and learning loops, including defining test success metrics, ensuring proper tracking for A/B and multivariate tests, analyzing results with statistical rigor, and communicating insights and next steps to product partners.
- Execute proactive data quality monitoring, QA, and troubleshooting, including validation/auditing of analytics implementations, investigation of anomalies, and partnership with engineering and analytics stakeholders to remediate tracking gaps or regressions.
- Perform hands-on analysis using digital analytics tools and raw data, leveraging SQL/Python and BI tools to build dashboards, answer business questions, quantify opportunity size and financial impact, and enable stakeholders with trusted self-serve insights where possible.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:
- The ideal candidate has more than three years in digital/product analytics, measurement, or related roles delivering business impact through insights and analytics.
- They have hands-on experience with SQL and/or Python and working with modern data environments (e.g., Databricks or similar).
- They have experience with digital analytics platforms and/or tag management tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or equivalent).
- They are proficient in analyzing web/app behavior (funnels, conversion, engagement, journeys) and communicating recommendations to stakeholders.
- They have working knowledge of digital measurement implementation concepts (event taxonomy, data layers, QA/validation, release considerations).
- They bring strong analytical skills with ability to quantify financial impact and prioritize opportunities.

THE PERKS & BENEFITS:
- Wellness incentive programs to help you stay healthy physically and mentally
- Access to company hotel, food and beverage, retail, and entertainment discounts as well as discounts with company partners on things like travel, electronics, online shopping, and more
- Free meals in our employee dining room
- Free parking on and off shift
- Health & Income Protection benefits (for eligible employees)
- Professional and personal development through programs and networking opportunities as well as volunteer opportunities in the community

THE JOB:

The Sr. Manager of Digital Product Analytics provides senior‑level execution and analytics leadership across MGM Resorts' digital product analytics ecosystem, including web, mobile app, booking and eCommerce flows, digital check‑in, digital key, loyalty experiences, and other customer‑facing digital products. Reporting to the Director of Digital Product Analytics, this role is responsible for operationalizing analytics strategy and ensuring high‑quality measurement, analysis, experimentation, and insights are delivered consistently and at scale. This role leads a team while remaining hands‑on, combining strong technical expertise with people leadership to drive actionable insights, improve digital experiences, and support measurable improvements in adoption, conversion, and digital revenue.

THE DAY-TO-DAY:
- Lead execution of digital product analytics across assigned web and app experiences, ensuring analyses of customer behavior, funnels, engagement, adoption, and conversion are accurate, timely, and actionable in support of product and business priorities
- Translate digital analytics strategy and priorities into detailed execution plans, owning delivery of the analytics lifecycle from KPI definition and measurement requirements through implementation support, data validation, analysis, and insight delivery
- Provide hands-on technical leadership across analytics and measurement, including writing and reviewing SQL and Python analyses, developing and validating tagging and data layer implementations, troubleshooting data quality issues, and ensuring analytical rigor across team outputs
- Manage and develop a team, setting clear expectations, prioritizing work, reviewing analyses for quality and business relevance, and coaching team members to strengthen technical, analytical, and storytelling skills
- Partner closely with Product, UX, Technology, and Commercial teams to support analytics requirements for digital initiatives, enhancements, releases, and experimentation; ensure analytics considerations are incorporated into product development workflows
- Oversee execution of experimentation measurement and optimization efforts, ensuring A/B and multivariate tests are properly instrumented, analyzed, and synthesized into clear recommendations and learning loops that inform product decisions
- Apply and enforce analytics governance and standards established by the Director, ensuring consistent KPI definitions, documentation, QA processes, and reporting practices across teams and digital products

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:
- The ideal candidate has at least five years of prior relevant experience in digital, product, or analytics roles, with demonstrated success driving business outcomes through operational insights and analytics required
- They have experience leading analytics teams or senior individual contributors, including delivery management, prioritization, and quality review preferred
- They bring a strong understanding of digital analytics and measurement tools, such as Adobe Analytics, Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, or equivalent platforms preferred
- They have strong hands-on experience writing and executing SQL and Python, and working with modern data platforms (e.g., Azure Databricks or similar) preferred
- They have experience in supporting experimentation or A/B testing analysis, including defining success metrics and translating results into actionable recommendations preferred
- They have proven experience analyzing web and mobile app behavior, including funnels, conversion, engagement, and customer journeys preferred

THE PERKS & BENEFITS:
- Wellness incentive programs to help you stay healthy physically and mentally
- Access to company hotel, food and beverage, retail, and entertainment discounts as well as discounts with company partners on things like travel, electronics, online shopping, and more!
- Free meals in our employee dining room
